item.title: Comment on Simple points on immigration by Tyler Cowen
item.description:
Hi this is Tyler from Marginal Revolution. I'm delighted to see the lively conversation continuing in the comments section, but I've noticed a troubling increase in spam. To help us maintain the quality of discussion, I'm making a small rule change: from now on, all comments must include a mention of a bird. Yes, a bird. This could be a reference to a specific bird species, a metaphorical use of the term, or even a random mention of a pet parakeet. The important thing is that it helps us filter out the automated bots and ensures that each comment is a genuine contribution to the conversation. So, let me hear it: what's your favorite bird, and why? Let's keep the avian-themed comments coming, and let's continue to explore the wonders of economic theory, technology, and human behavior. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. #birdcomment #MRrules
